snippet.title: Marvel’s Wolverine | D23 Showcase Sizzle
snippet.description:
Logan, Jean Grey, and Team X stand against Bolivar Trask and deadly villains in the latest trailer for Marvel's #WolverinePS5, unveiled during the D23 Showcase. 

Marvel's #WolverinePS5 releases September 15 on PlayStation 5. Pre-order now!
